name: Plainpins: Travel Pin Map
subtitle: Pin the places you've been
promotional_text: A pin for everywhere you have been, with the photos, the day, who came along and what you did. No account, no subscription, nothing leaves your iPhone.
description:
Plainpins is a map of where you have been. Put a pin on a place, then add the photos, the day you were there, who came along and what you did. Zoom out and the whole thing sits on a globe you can spin.

It is made to be looked at. Each place opens like a page in an atlas: its photos, the story in your words, the date and the people. Flick through your places along the bottom of the map and it flies to each one.

- A pin for every place, in a color for its kind: beaches, parks, trails, towns, food, museums, stays, events and landmarks
- Photos from your library or the camera, kept with the place
- The day, or the first and last day of a longer stay
- Who was there, with names you have used before one tap away
- What you did, in as many words as you like
- Search for a place by name, or move the map under the pin
- A list of every place by year, with search and filters by kind, person or favorite
- A count of your places, towns and countries
- A backup you control: one file with every place and photo, saved wherever you choose and restored on a new iPhone
- Dark mode, and text that follows your iPhone's text size

Nothing leaves your iPhone unless you send it. There is no account to create and no server: your places and photos are stored in the app, and you decide where a backup goes. The map itself is Apple Maps.

Free for your first 25 places, with 6 photos on each and every feature. Plainpins Pro holds as many places as you have been, 40 photos on each, and adds the satellite globe. It is one payment, not a subscription, and nothing you have added is ever locked.

support._about: This app's section on the apps' support page (tools/site_pages.py). Every answer must match what the app shows.
support.restore: Open the Settings tab: Restore purchase is in the first group, under Plainpins Pro. It is also at the bottom of the Pro screen.
support.backup: Open the Settings tab and find Your data. Back up makes one file with every place and photo: save it to iCloud Drive or a computer, or AirDrop it to yourself. On the new iPhone, open Settings and tap Restore from a backup.

more.q: What does the free version include?
more.a: Every feature for your first 25 places, with 6 photos on each. Plainpins Pro holds as many places as you like, 40 photos on each, and adds the satellite globe, with one payment. Nothing you have added is ever locked.

more.q: How do I add a place?
more.a: On the Map tab, tap the + button. Search for the place, or move the map until the pin sits on it, then tap Put the pin here. Add photos, the day, who was there and what you did, and tap Save.

more.q: How do I move a pin or change a place?
more.a: Open the place and tap the pencil. To move the pin, delete the place and add it again in the right spot; its photos can be added again from your library.

more.q: Are my photos copied or moved?
more.a: Copied. The app keeps its own copy of each photo you add, so the place keeps its pictures even if you later delete them from your library. Your library is not changed.

privacy_label.note: For App Store Connect > App Privacy: 'Data Not Collected'. The app has no server, no account, no analytics and no ads. The map is Apple's MapKit and place search and town names come from Apple's geocoder, both part of iOS; the developer receives nothing. Location is read on the device only when the person taps the locate button. Pro is bought straight from the App Store (StoreKit) with no purchase service in between.
privacy_label.everything_else: Not collected. Places, photos, dates, names and notes never leave the device.

products.description: Unlimited places and the satellite globe.
products.review_note: Unlocks more than 25 places, up to 40 photos on a place and the satellite map style. Open the Settings tab and tap Plainpins Pro to see the purchase screen. Restore purchase is on the same screen.

product_id_note: Store product id = bundle id + '.pro'. The app uses exactly this id (apps/plainpins/src/pro/config.ts) and reads the product, its local price and whether it is owned straight from the App Store on the iPhone. $6.99 is the studio default; the owner has not set a price for this app.

review_notes:
Plainpins is a personal map of places a person has visited. There is no account and no sign-in, and the app has no server: everything a person enters stays on the iPhone.

The map is Apple Maps (MapKit). Place search and the town name under a new pin use Apple's geocoder. Location is asked for only when the locate button is tapped while placing a pin, and is used once to center the map. The photo library and the camera are used only when a person adds photos to a place; the app keeps its own copy.

The one in-app purchase is Plainpins Pro (non-consumable, com.gamequarry.plainpins.pro). To see it: open the Settings tab and tap Plainpins Pro. It also opens when + is tapped with 25 places already added, when a seventh photo is added to a place, or when Satellite is chosen as the map style. Restore purchase is on the Pro screen and in Settings.

The backup file is made on the device and handed to the share sheet.
